rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the lower part of the face, especially in expressions like a dropped jaw.

example.english: They hit their jaw on the corner of the table, and it stayed swollen all day.
example.traditional: 佢個下巴撞到枱角，腫咗成日。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 haa6 paa4 zong6 dou3 ci4 gok3 zung2 zo2 seng4 jat6

rows.note: Use this for the jawbone itself, especially when referring to its anatomical or tooth-bearing function.

example.english: My jaw hurts so much that I can't eat.
example.traditional: 我隻牙骹痛到食唔到嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 ngaa4 gaau3 tung3 dou3 sik6 m4 dou3 je5
